name: Touma Rurika
source:
A nurse who admires the head nurse and is hostile towards men. She is strong-willed and has a harsh attitude towards the main character.

She is a typical tsundere, and at first she takes the place of the head nurse to help her. She reluctantly has a relationship with the main character, but as they get closer, she becomes possessive.

She is a spoiled brat who clings to him at every turn. At first she appears to have a sadistic personality, but deep down she is a masochist and easily gets rope-sick.

Although she lacks knowledge, she is interested in sex, and although she is timid, she becomes deeply addicted to the world of pleasure.

Born on a southern island, she has healthy brown skin. Although she is the "smallest" in the clinic, she still has huge breasts that befit her physique.

[spoiler] Director Kashima takes her and the other nurses on his trip abroad. She returns mid story in the sequel, angry that she isn't receiving the protagonist's love.[/spoiler]
